scripts.build: npm run build -w @quizzeira/shared && npm run build -w @quizzeira/api && npm run build -w @quizzeira/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @quizzeira/shared && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/discovery-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/discovery-crawler --noEmit && tsc -p apps/content-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/content-worker --noEmit && tsc -p apps/content-quality --noEmit && tsc -p apps/quiz-corrector --noEmit && tsc -b apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:worker-kit && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:api && npm run test:content && npm run test:quality && npm run test:discovery && npm run test:doc-processor
scripts.test:doc-processor: cd apps/doc-processor && python3 -m pytest -q tests/ && PYTHONPATH=. python3 scripts/check_schema_contract.py
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate -w @quizzeira/api && npm run db:generate -w @quizzeira/discovery-api && npm run db:generate -w @quizzeira/content-api
